Before Year 0 · choosing a civilization

Three candidates from the generator, each a real star with an invented world and people, and the mind they wake as. All three start equal: the same kit, stocks and budgets. They differ in character and place. The player looks closer at one, names it, and accepts its founding line. Then it wakes.

tap Veyra ›choose ›

First seconds · waking, remembering, and what you inherit

After choosing and naming a civilization. The mind wakes and remembers, as its own memory: where Veyra comes from, who its people are, and where things stand at Year 0. Each can be skipped. Then it sees what Veyra already has: Earth’s instruments and industry today, plus about a century. The kit found the opening clues. Every project goes beyond it.

where we come from ›who they are ›tap ⤢ ›Front ›Face ›where things stand ›see what you inherit ›

First session · the guided tour

Six stops after landing, before anything is under way. The rest of Home is left to discovery. The Projects stop is where time gets explained. Skippable, and replayable from the Mind tab.
